name: Multi-Channel Page-Table Hierarchy
definition: A data structure that virtualizes a bricked multi-volume hierarchy by implementing a paged 3D address space. It uses one page-table hierarchy per channel to keep track of brick locations in a shared brick cache, allowing direct access to any brick without traversing a tree structure.
summary: Multi-Channel Page-Table Hierarchy is a GPU-driven structure that virtualizes multi-resolution, multi-channel volumes via paged 3D address space, enabling direct brick access without tree traversal.
